name: agent-config-audit
short: Checks your AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, hooks and settings for duplicate rules and stale files, then reports back.
what: A skill that finds every agent instruction file in your workspace (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, agent settings and hooks, memory files) and checks them for duplicated rules, stale files, broken paths and settings drift. It writes a report with critical, moderate and minor findings plus a fix plan. By default it changes nothing.
who: Anyone whose agent keeps making the same mistake despite rules that should stop it, or who has config files spread across several repos. With one short CLAUDE.md you won't get much from it.
needs: Node.js for `npx`, or Claude Code for the plugin route

steps.title: Install the skills
steps.text: This installs the whole collection (169 skills) for the three agents named. Don't use `--all`, which installs to every agent the CLI knows (30+).
steps.code: npx skills add shipshitdev/skills -g --agent claude-code codex cursor --skill '*' -y

steps.title: Or, in Claude Code, install just the Dev Workflow bundle

try.label: From the SKILL.md
try.where: Your coding agent, at the workspace root
try.text:
audit CLAUDE.md

Or ask it to check your agent config for duplicated rules and stale files.

watch: Fix mode edits your agent config files. It only starts when you ask for fixes and confirm the exact plan, and a request to sync configs doesn't count.
It asks before overwriting configs or deleting or merging duplicated rules.
The repo's old `scripts/install-skills.sh` installer was removed. The README says not to run an old copy.
